onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.description: DeepVault is a local-first command center for browsing documents, asking grounded questions with Bishop, and monitoring sync status without depending on a hosted backend at day one.
onboarding.explorerDescription: Browse the corpus, inspect documents, and read source-backed summaries.
onboarding.bishopDescription: Ask permission-aware questions and inspect the answer trace.
onboarding.knowledgeDescription: Track ingestion coverage, refresh timing, and provider readiness.
onboarding.aiViewDescription: Review response confidence and the inputs that would help the next answer.
